Processing
Internet Archive source is an MP3; Commons holds an Ogg Vorbis conversion and supplies an MP3 derivative. Embedded Vorbis encoder: Lavc58.35.100 libvorbis. Documented

No restoration settings or original transfer chain are documented. The embedded DATE=2001 is not the 1932 session date.

[4] [3]
Composition rights
Original composition is public domain in ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions. Inferred, not documented

The review identifies Beethoven as 1770–⁠1827. This conclusion does not extend to Schnabel’s sound recording.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis). Documented

Commons applies PD-EU-audio to Schnabel’s 1932 HMV recording. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.

[9] [10] [11]
